en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, form Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Aban Bin Usman, from Abu Maryam, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The old girl who has a father for her, cannot get married without the permission of her father’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If she was in control of her affairs, she can get married whenever she so desires to’.
en.sarwar: 2. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla’ ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Aban ibn ‘Uthman from abu Maryam who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The virgin girl who has her father must not marry without his permission.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘If she has control over her affairs she can marry whenever she wants.’”
